claims.claim: Cyprus has no wealth tax

sources.name: PwC: quick chart, net wealth/worth tax rates
sources.says: Headline net wealth/worth tax rate: Greece "NA" (last reviewed 08 September 2026), Cyprus "NA" (04 August 2026), Croatia "NA" (27 August 2026), Bulgaria "NA" (02 August 2026). "NA" is defined as "Not Applicable (i.e. the territory does not have the indicated tax or requirement)".

claims.claim: Dividends and interest are exempt from income tax

sources.name: PwC: Cyprus, individual, income determination
sources.says: Last reviewed 04 August 2026. Dividend and interest income "received by individuals are exempt from PIT but are subject to SDC". SDC applies only to individuals who are both Cyprus tax resident and Cyprus domiciled; for those not domiciled, "dividend and (most types of) interest income for such individuals are exempt from all taxes in Cyprus." Profits from disposals of shares, bonds and fund units are exempt from income tax.

sources.name: EY Cyprus: tax alert, February 2026 (tax reform legislation)
sources.says: Dated 26 February 2026. Domiciled individuals' dividends are "subject to 5% SDC" (17% for pre-2026 profits of Cypriot companies paid by 31 December 2031); interest "will no longer be subject to income tax and it will instead be subject to a 17% SDC". A former non-dom "may choose to be subject to an alternative way of SDC for up to two five-year periods" by an upfront payment of €250,000 per five-year period. Nothing on GHS contributions for non-doms.

claims.claim: A non-domiciled resident pays no Special Defence Contribution until resident 17 of the last 20 years

sources.name: PwC: Cyprus, individual, taxes on personal income
sources.says: Last reviewed 04 August 2026. SDC on dividends: "17% for profits of tax years up to 2025" "or 5% for profits of tax years as of 2026"; on interest 17% (3% on certain bonds). SDC is charged on income "earned by individuals who are both Cyprus tax resident and Cyprus domiciled for the purposes of the SDC". An individual without a Cyprus domicile of origin is treated as domiciled only after being tax resident for "at least 17 years out of the last 20 years prior to the tax year in question".

sources.name: PwC: Cyprus, individual, income determination
sources.says: Last reviewed 04 August 2026. Dividend and interest income "received by individuals are exempt from PIT but are subject to SDC". SDC applies only to individuals who are both Cyprus tax resident and Cyprus domiciled; for those not domiciled, "dividend and (most types of) interest income for such individuals are exempt from all taxes in Cyprus." Profits from disposals of shares, bonds and fund units are exempt from income tax.

claims.note: The 2026 reform (in force 1 January 2026) cut SDC on dividends to 5% for domiciled residents, on profits from 2026; it did not change the non-dom exemption. The Tax Department's own pages were not found in an HTML form (its GHS guidance on mof.gov.cy is a PDF). Paphos's `why` ("non-dom dividends and interest effectively capped at the 2.65% health levy") agrees; scores.tax stays 5.
